stories.text: 🚨 MEDIAN FLIP: TDsMaGee just moved above the projected league median.
🚨 RULED OUT: S. Darnold won't play, and he's in Mr. Action Jackson's lineup. Next man up Drew Lock is on waivers. Kickoff's Sunday 4:25 PM.
🪦 The eulogy is in: In My Fantasy Era gets its send-off (15.39 pts short). Read it on the Death Watch tab, and bring tissues.
🎯 PLAYOFF SWING: Ruffing the Passer vs Mr. Action Jackson. Playoff odds with a win / loss: Ruffing the Passer 45% / 20%, Mr. Action Jackson 88% / 65%.
🔮 49er Faith-Fool vs Beautiful Dark Twisted Fantasy is tightening — the projected margin shrank to 8.33 pts.
🎯 TWO WINS: Ruffing the Passer: 48% playoff odds with 2 wins this week, 15% with none (now 37%).
📈 LINE MOVE: JAX @ BAL: BAL −4.5 at open, JAX −10 now. 9 league starters in it, led by B. Tuten (Kyle Tucker).
📈 LINE MOVE: NYG @ PHI: PHI −5.5 at open, NYG −3.5 now. 3 league starters in it, led by S. Barkley (Beautiful Dark Twisted Fantasy).
🤝 Rivalry week: Gibb it to Me Baby leads The Mahomies 4–3 all-time.
🎤 BYE BYE BYE: The Mahomies has 2 starters on bye this week (Metcalf and Boswell). Somebody call *NSYNC.
🪑 Bench of broken dreams: Ruffing the Passer has started Keenan Allen just once. Starting him in Weeks 3, 5 and 6 would have meant 1 more win by now.
🔁 Retro trade: If TDsMaGee and Gibb it to Me Baby had swapped Michael Wilson for Quinshon Judkins back in Week 5, both would be ahead (+2 wins each).
📈 Beautiful Dark Twisted Fantasy was down to 11% against Gibb it to Me Baby — and won.
💓 Ruffing the Passer outlasted The Mahomies after the favorite flipped 5 times.
